g.text: C. OUTPUT AND INTERFACES: 3.3 V permission is for the carrier MOSFET gate only; carrier feedback is 5 V.

g.desc: C. OUTPUT AND INTERFACES: 3.3 V permission is for the carrier MOSFET gate only; carrier feedback is 5 V.

g.text: E. SUPPLY FLAGS: rails are externally driven or passively fed; flags are not physical components.

g.desc: E. SUPPLY FLAGS: rails are externally driven or passively fed; flags are not physical components.

g.text: D. PASSIVES: connected by named nets; place each U's 100 nF physically at its supply pins.

g.desc: D. PASSIVES: connected by named nets; place each U's 100 nF physically at its supply pins.

g.text: Output is not a semantic command/plausibility monitor. Driver/relay/ECU timing requires measured bench validation.

g.desc: Output is not a semantic command/plausibility monitor. Driver/relay/ECU timing requires measured bench validation.

g.text: J3: external held DPST-NO enable, no jumper in deployed setup. J4: separate normally-open ARM button.

g.desc: J3: external held DPST-NO enable, no jumper in deployed setup. J4: separate normally-open ARM button.

g.text: B. QUALIFICATION AND ARM: asynchronous fault clear; two heartbeat stages; fresh physical ARM edge.

g.desc: B. QUALIFICATION AND ARM: asynchronous fault clear; two heartbeat stages; fresh physical ARM edge.

g.text: A. POWER AND WATCHDOG: rail monitors remain independent of the ESP application.

g.desc: A. POWER AND WATCHDOG: rail monitors remain independent of the ESP application.

g.text: BENCH ONLY: regulated 5.0 V + shared ESP 3.3 V; keep disconnected from vehicle.

g.desc: BENCH ONLY: regulated 5.0 V + shared ESP 3.3 V; keep disconnected from vehicle.

g.text: Hardware: window watchdog + both rail supervisors + physical held enable + READY -> asynchronous latch clear.

g.desc: Hardware: window watchdog + both rail supervisors + physical held enable + READY -> asynchronous latch clear.

g.text: Two post-READY WDI falling edges -> HB_GOOD; fresh physical ARM rising edge with requests all LOW -> ARMED.

g.desc: Two post-READY WDI falling edges -> HB_GOOD; fresh physical ARM rising edge with requests all LOW -> ARMED.

g.text: 3.3 V COIL_PERMIT is only for relay gate input. External enable pole J3(1-2) physically interrupts coil power.

g.desc: 3.3 V COIL_PERMIT is only for relay gate input. External enable pole J3(1-2) physically interrupts coil power.

g.text: J5 pin 7 returns carrier post-enable/pre-cutoff 5 V: R22 monitors actual feed; never connect this 5 V wire to ESP.

g.desc: J5 pin 7 returns carrier post-enable/pre-cutoff 5 V: R22 monitors actual feed; never connect this 5 V wire to ESP.
